statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-38827 affects Spring Framework's authorization rules when using locale-dependent String.toLowerCase() and String.toUpperCase(). The fix requires Spring Framework 6.1.14, a major version jump from the current 5.3.39. Upgrading to Spring 6.x would require Java 17 baseline and significant API changes incompatible with Data Prepper's current architecture. The vulnerability requires an application to use Spring Security with locale-sensitive authorization rules. Data Prepper does not use Spring Security; authentication is handled via HTTP Basic in the management API configuration. Investigation ongoing for a backport or alternative mitigation.

The fix requires Spring Framework 6.1.14, a major version jump from the current 5.3.39. Upgrading to Spring 6.x would require Java 17 baseline and significant API changes incompatible with Data Prepper's current architecture. The vulnerability requires an application to use Spring Security with locale-sensitive authorization rules. Data Prepper does not use Spring Security; authentication is handled via HTTP Basic in the management API configuration. Investigation ongoing for a backport or alternative mitigation.

CVE-2024-38827 is a Spring Security advisory (spring-security-core AuthorizationManager case-sensitivity). Data Prepper ships Spring Framework 5.3.39 but does not depend on Spring Security, so the vulnerable component is not present in the image.
